meta.name: git-commit
meta.description: Execute git commit with conventional commit message analysis, intelligent staging, and message generation. Use when user asks to commit changes, create a git commit, or mentions "/commit". Supports: (1) Auto-detecting type and scope from changes, (2) Generating conventional commit messages from diff, (3) Interactive commit with optional type/scope/description overrides, (4) Intelligent file staging for logical grouping

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 提交代码时自动生成清晰的提交说明
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常需要提交代码并希望提交说明规范清晰
copy.tagline_en: Generate clear commit messages automatically when you commit code
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often commit code and want clear and conventional commit messages

howto.what: 装上后，当你要求提交代码时，Claude 会按 Conventional Commits 规范分析改动，自动判断提交类型和影响范围，智能暂存文件，并生成规范的单行或多行提交消息；还会识别破坏性变更，并避免提交密钥等敏感文件。
howto.when: 当你要求提交更改、创建 git commit，或提到 "/commit" 时触发。它会先检查暂存区和工作区差异，必要时先执行 git add 再提交。

say.text: 帮我提交这些改动，用 conventional commit 格式
say.note: Claude 会分析 diff 并生成规范提交消息。

say.text: 用 /commit 提交当前更改，类型设为 fix
say.note: 它会按 fix 类型生成消息并提交。

say.text: 提交时把相关文件分组，并加上 BREAKING CHANGE 标注
say.note: 它会智能暂存文件并识别破坏性变更。

howto.what_en: When you ask to commit code, Claude analyzes the diff per Conventional Commits, auto-detects type and scope, stages files intelligently, and generates a standardized single- or multi-line commit message. It also flags breaking changes and avoids committing secrets.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to commit changes, create a git commit, or mention "/commit". It checks staged and working-tree diffs, staging files first if needed.

say_en.text: Commit these changes using conventional commit format
say_en.note: Claude analyzes the diff and generates a proper message.

say_en.text: Use /commit for current changes with type fix
say_en.note: It creates a fix-type message and commits.

say_en.text: Group related files and add BREAKING CHANGE footer
say_en.note: It stages files intelligently and detects breaking changes.
